title: Find Home Builder Company Phone Numbers With LinkFinder AI
coverSub: From a list of company names to their phone numbers
cover: In this video we are going to see how to find home builder company phone numbers in bulk using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: Here is what you end up with. 7 company names went in, and every one came back with its phone number, ready to export. Now let's see how.
outro: That's the whole flow: a list of companies in, phone numbers out. Click the first link in the description to create your free account and run your own list. Next, watch how to find the emails of these same companies.
outroHeadline: Run your own home builder list
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results from the LinkFinder AI API (data/lookups.json), checked by tools/gen360.py

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Choose Company name, main line. It costs one credit per company.
Fill in the company name. We type D.R. Horton.
In a couple of seconds you get 8 1 7 3 9 0 8 2 0 0.
Now do it for a whole list. Click Upload CSV, bulk.
Click Select File and pick your CSV. One column of company names is enough. Ours has 7, from Lennar to Meritage Homes.
You see the rows before anything runs, so you know exactly what you will spend.
The phone numbers come in row by row while you watch.
7 companies in, 7 phone numbers out, every one marked Found.
Click Export to download the list as a CSV, ready for your CRM or your next enrichment.
